Agarwal Residence

Complete Home Interior – Living, Dining, Kitchen, Bedrooms & Bathrooms

A 2,500 sq.ft. complete home interior in Balurghat, designed as one continuous open-plan living, dining and kitchen space in soft sage and light oak, with a brass lattice feature wall, glass-block partitions, a calm master suite, a playful kids' room and two distinctly styled bathrooms.

Location
Balurghat, West Bengal
Area
2500 sq.ft.
Type
Residential Interior
Style
Soft Contemporary
Year
2024
Client
Shubham Agarwal
About

Designed for the Shubham Agarwal family in Balurghat, this 2,500 sq.ft. residence was planned as a complete home interior, from the living room and kitchen to the bedrooms, bathrooms and balcony. The aim was a home that feels calm, bright and connected, with each room given its own character within a single design language.

Living, dining and kitchen form one continuous open plan, unified by soft sage, light oak and continuous cove lighting. A backlit brass lattice wall gives the living room its focal point, an aqua glass-block partition shares light between zones, and a high-gloss sage U-shaped kitchen with a breakfast counter keeps everyday cooking and family time together.

The private spaces shift in mood. The master suite is serene, with a marble-finish headboard wall and fluted wardrobes. The kids' room becomes a playful sky of balloons, clouds and a glowing moon, with a built-in study. The two bathrooms take different directions, one bold in green tile and gold, the other calm and minimal, while the balcony extends the home outdoors with a warm wood-slat ceiling and wicker seating.

A Brass Lattice Living Room
The sofa wall is anchored by a backlit brass geometric lattice panel with a sunburst centrepiece, framed in light oak panelling with brass globe sconces. Opposite, a marble-finish TV wall sits between sage fluted panels and open bookshelves, while an aqua glass-block partition brings light and colour into the space.
One Continuous Open Plan
Living, dining and kitchen are planned as a single, uninterrupted run. Continuous cove lighting, a consistent sage-and-oak palette and the glass-block partition tie the zones together, so the home reads as one generous, connected space.
Dining & Wash Area
A solid wood dining table with boucle chairs sits beside the kitchen counter, under Roman blinds framed in oak. A floating wash basin is set against a backlit feature wall with sculpted stone forms, beside the glass-block partition.
A Sage U-Shaped Kitchen
High-gloss sage cabinetry wraps a U-shaped kitchen with a breakfast counter and bar stools. Black-framed glass shutters, a floor-to-ceiling lit crockery unit and pendant lights over the counter add definition without breaking the soft palette.
A Calm Master Suite
The master bedroom pairs an upholstered panel headboard with a veined marble-finish wall and slim brass inlays, flanked by globe wall lights. Full-height wardrobes with sage fluted inserts and long brass handles keep the room serene and uncluttered.
A Kids' Room Above the Clouds
Hot-air balloon wallpaper, an arched fluted headboard, backlit cloud cut-outs and a glowing moon panel turn the kids' room into a soft, playful sky. A built-in study desk with lit shelving and a wardrobe with a playful graphic shutter make it practical for growing children.
Two Bathrooms, Two Moods
One bathroom pairs green picket-tile shower walls with terrazzo, a fluted glass partition and brushed gold fittings. The other is calm and minimal, with fluted wall cladding, a sculpted pentagon mirror, a vessel basin and a warm wood-slat ceiling.
Highlights
Brass Lattice Feature Wall
A backlit geometric brass panel with sunburst centrepiece anchors the living room.
Glass-Block Partition
An aqua glass-block wall separates zones while sharing light across the open plan.
Unified Sage & Oak Palette
The same sage and light oak run through living, kitchen, bedrooms and joinery.
Continuous Cove Lighting
Perimeter cove lines and recessed downlights stitch the open-plan zones together.
Themed Kids' Room
Balloon wallpaper, backlit clouds and a moon panel with a built-in study unit.
Every Room Designed
Living, dining, kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and the balcony in one scheme.
